testimonials.title: Real Stories from Newcomers and Helpers
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from people who took decisive steps in the Netherlands through the postal address programme.

testimonial1.author: Fatima Al-Mansoor
testimonial1.text: Without a permanent rental contract, the municipality of Amsterdam wouldn't let me register for a BSN. Through Immigratiepunt, I was matched with helper Jan for a postal address within two days. With the official declaration, my municipal appointment was sorted within a week.

testimonial2.author: Jan de Vries
testimonial2.text: I provide my address for official letters for newcomers. It takes me only a few minutes a week to log incoming mail in the portal. The compensation easily covers my monthly donation, and I genuinely help someone get on their feet.

testimonial3.author: Oleksandr Petrenko
testimonial3.text: Right after getting my BSN, I was able to open a Dutch bank account via partner Xabi World for my salary. Djobba then helped rewrite my CV to Dutch recruitment standards. Practical, straightforward, and zero empty promises.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Straightforward answers about the postal address programme, BSN appointments, and partner services.
faq.question1: How quickly can I apply for a BSN with a postal address?
faq.answer1: Once matched with a helper, you receive the signed consent form for a postal address (under Art. 2.45 Dutch BRP Act). You can immediately schedule an appointment at your municipality's civil affairs desk. Depending on municipal wait times, you typically receive your BSN in 1 to 3 weeks.
faq.question2: Do I need to speak Dutch to use your services?
faq.answer2: No. Our advisors and online portal are fully bilingual in Dutch and English, and we support document assistance in Spanish, Portuguese, Turkish, German, Russian, and Arabic.
faq.question3: How does Immigratiepunt help with finding housing?
faq.answer3: Through our partner WoningVry, you gain access to vetted rental properties and rooms. We review lease agreements for unlawful clauses, excessive service charges, and tenant protection rights to keep you safe from rental scams.
faq.question4: How does opening a bank account via Xabi World work?
faq.answer4: As soon as your BSN is issued, you can open an official Dutch current account (IBAN) through partner Xabi World within 48 hours, complete with full iDEAL support, mobile banking, and a debit card for your salary.
faq.question5: What exactly is a postal address (briefadres)?
faq.answer5: A postal address (formally: briefadres) is an address recognised by the municipality for official correspondence without resident registration. It does not affect the helper's municipal taxes, rental rights, or allowances.
faq.question6: What does offering a postal address earn me as a helper?
faq.answer6: You receive a tiered fee from €0.50 up to €5.00 per logged letter. Helpers also contribute €5 per month to support the platform; this donation is quickly recouped after just a few letters.

what.title: What is a postal address?
what.text: An address where a newcomer's mail is sent. The municipality uses it as a correspondence address so someone without a fixed home address can still apply for a BSN.

not.title: What it is not
not.text: A postal address is NOT a residential registration at your address. Nothing changes about your living situation, rental contract or benefits — it is purely an address for mail.

why.title: Why it helps
why.text: With a BSN a newcomer can open a bank account, work and get insured. Your address is often the first step that sets everything in motion.

steps.title: Helper in three steps
steps.subtitle: From sign-up to first piece of mail — we arrange the match and the handling.

step1.title: Sign up
step1.description: Register as a postal address helper. We verify your details and explain the programme personally.

step2.title: We match you
step2.description: You are matched with one or more newcomers who use your address as a postal address for their BSN application.

step3.title: Receive mail and compensation
step3.description: For every piece of mail arriving via your address you receive €0.50 to €5. The more mail, the higher the amount.

earnings.title: Earn per piece of mail
earnings.subtitle: Compensation starts at €0.50 per piece of mail and rises to €5. You also donate €5 per month to support the programme — a donation you can earn back through the compensation.

start.label: Starting rate
start.text: Per piece of mail received, from the very first one. The baseline to get started.

growth.label: Maximum rate
growth.text: The more mail you receive, the higher the amount per piece — up to a maximum of €5.

donation.label: Monthly donation
donation.text: Every helper contributes €5 per month to support newcomers — so you are partly a donor too.

earnings.note: The maths: you donate €5 per month, but earn it back through the per-mail compensation. At ten pieces of mail a month at €0.50 your donation is already covered — everything above that is net earnings, and you help someone obtain a BSN.

legalCard.title: Legal Framework for Postal Address
legalCard.intro: Dutch legislation (Personal Records Database Act) guarantees anyone temporarily lacking a fixed residential address the right to an official postal address (briefadres). This prevents newcomers from falling outside the system.
legalCard.point1Title: No effect on helper's municipal taxes
legalCard.point1Desc: A postal address provider is never counted as a co-resident for municipal waste charges, housing benefits, or welfare.
legalCard.point2Desc: The helper signs the municipal declaration enabling the newcomer to register at the civil affairs department.
legalCard.point3Desc: Helpers never open letters; they only log the official sender into the secure portal.

mission.title: Why Immigratiepunt Exists
mission.text1: Every year, thousands of motivated people come to the Netherlands to work, study, or build a new life. However, many get stuck in a bureaucratic catch-22: without a permanent address you cannot register for a BSN, without a BSN you cannot open a bank account, and without a bank account you cannot sign a lease or receive your salary.
mission.text2: Immigratiepunt was founded to break this cycle immediately. By connecting private individuals who provide their address as a temporary postal address (in compliance with Art. 2.45 Dutch BRP Act), newcomers obtain the key to official registration.

values.title: Our Approach & Principles
values.val1Text: Direct personal contact in your own language through consultants who explain Dutch rules clearly.
values.val2Text: A postal address is strictly for correspondence (briefadres) and has no impact on the helper's taxes, rent allowances, or welfare benefits.
values.val3Text: Helpers receive clear tiered compensation per received letter (€0.50 to €5.00) in return for their commitment.
values.val4Text: From postal address and BSN appointment to a Dutch IBAN via Xabi World, followed by guidance into housing and employment.
